findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_video, list_series, create_series, update_series, draft_video, get_character_sheet, quote_character_episode, plan_drama_season, get_season_plan · Private data: create_video, list_social_accounts, get_connection_status, publish_video · Public sink: list_social_accounts, publish_video, list_series, create_series, update_series, update_draft, create_character_sheet, quote_character_episode · Destructive: create_series, update_series, resume_series, quote_character_episode, save_season_plan.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: create_video, list_series, create_series, update_series, draft_video, get_character_sheet, quote_character_episode, plan_drama_season, get_season_plan · Private data: create_video, list_social_accounts, get_connection_status, publish_video · Public sink: list_social_accounts, publish_video, list_series, create_series, update_series, update_draft, create_character_sheet, quote_character_episode · Destructive: create_series, update_series, resume_series, quote_character_episode, save_season_plan

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
